content.short: BR Softech is a leading game development company with 12+ years of industry experience and trusted expertise.
content.description: BR Softech is a Jaipur-based IT company with a global footprint, including branch offices in Singapore, the United States, and Australia. Backed by a team of 180+ skilled professionals, it delivers feature-rich, custom game development solutions tailored to client needs. The company's expertise spans game design and development, mobile game app development, and blockchain development services, enabling end-to-end delivery for Web3 gaming projects.
